nonclaims: A strict finite-rung sign does not prove an all-degree inequality or RH.
The checker does not establish that any one-feature choice works uniformly.
The signed target pivots are reported only to compare the finite diagnostics; they are not used in H_V.
The complete-positive-moment engine is hash-bound and reused, so this is a new calculation, not an independent re-audit of that engine.

normalization.spectral_scaling: m_j=4*pi*n_j; the common positive scale preserves every reported sign
normalization.target_archive: mu_j=4^j*M_j; outward serialization padding is applied before division

receipt_integrity.definition: sha256 of canonical compact sorted JSON with receipt_integrity omitted

scope: Bounded complete-theta finite-rung diagnostic for enlarging the two-generator score projection by one multiplication or prior-residual feature
